inputs.checklistItemText: Transformer pads lack minimum 5-foot clearance from retaining walls
inputs.question: On the site plan, identify all retaining walls shown. For each transformer pad, determine whether any retaining walls are located adjacent to or near the transformer pad. If retaining walls are present near any transformer pad, measure the minimum horizontal distance from the transformer pad edge to the nearest retaining wall. Indicate whether these distances meet or exceed 5 feet. Also note the location of the retaining walls (e.g., NE corner, south side, etc.).

output.reasoning: Although the agent question begins with presence/identification steps (finding retaining walls and transformer pads), the core directive is to measure the horizontal distance from transformer pad edge to nearest retaining wall and verify compliance with the 5-foot minimum clearance requirement, which is a measurement task.

argConstruction.explanation: Transformer pads are visible on the west side of the site, but there are no retaining walls located adjacent to or near them to measure.
